name: Solana

key_findings: Quantum Resistance Pass -- Winternitz Vault shipped live January 2025, a rare outright pass on this gate.
Real-World Utility (92) is SOL's strongest category -- deep, active real-world usage.
Decentralization (52) is a standing watch item -- Nakamoto Coefficient has declined from 31 to roughly 19-20.

binding_cap.short_note: Capped by Deterministic Finality Partial -- Alpenglow deterministic finality upgrade is testnet-only as of scoring.

key_findings: Raw AI fundamentals (78.0) reflect strong execution and tooling depth, held back mainly by the finality gate.
First chain bound by the Deterministic Finality gate specifically, rather than Operational Reliability or Programmability Tier.
Agent Tooling (90) is SOL's strongest AI category -- deep SDK, simulation, and agent-native infrastructure.

watch_items: Alpenglow (sub-200ms deterministic finality) targeted mainnet late Q3/early Q4 2026 -- would lift the Deterministic Finality Partial cap entirely once live.
Decentralization trend (validator count and Nakamoto Coefficient decline) -- watch for further downward revision.
